<thought>Based on the single measurement (6.667 Ω between A and X1) and the note that the subnetwork contains two resistors where one is twice the value of the other, the simplest topology that matches the data is a series connection of two resistors. Let the smaller resistor be R1 and the larger be R2 = 2·R1. Then R1 + R2 = 3·R1 = 6.667 Ω, giving R1 ≈ 2.222 Ω and R2 ≈ 4.444 Ω. The series connection can be represented with an intermediate node (e.g., N1) between the two resistors.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.444}, "connections": [["A", "N1", "R1"], ["N1", "X1", "R2"]]}</final_answer>
